text:
incident-bot: PAGER: elevated 5xx + timeouts on /v1/generate starting ~2026-03-15T15:02:00Z. Paging Alex (oncall). Symptoms: gateway 502/504 + backend timeouts. Impact: ~1.2% 5xx across region-us-west, spike at 15:02 UTC.
alex (oncall): ack. I’m on it — will gather traces and correlate correlation IDs. tagging @megan for tracing help.
megan (sre): looking. initial graphs show backlog at ingress proxy and a spike in upstream_retries around 15:01. Can someone paste a failing request log with corr id?
jay (runtime): copying a sample from kvlog. The gateway retried to model-backend-2 twice then timed out.
cho (ingress): here’s a raw snippet (sanitized):
```
2026-03-15T15:02:07Z gateway INFO req_id=ccf7a9 corr=02f1e2a3 path=/v1/generate upstream=model-backend-2 attempt=1 status=502 latency_ms=1200
2026-03-15T15:02:08Z gateway INFO req_id=ccf7a9 corr=02f1e2a3 path=/v1/generate upstream=model-backend-2 attempt=2 status=504 latency_ms=3000
2026-03-15T15:02:09Z gateway INFO req_id=ccf7a9 corr=02f1e2a3 path=/v1/generate upstream=model-backend-2 attempt=3 status=504 latency_ms=3001
```
cho (ingress): kvlog link: https://logs.redwood.test/kvlog?query=req_id%3Dccf7a9 (internal link)
megan (sre): thanks. i'm running a quick trace aggregation for corr=02f1e2a3 and other similar ids. early hypothesis: upstream process (model-backend-2) hit a resource exhaustion or GC pause causing retry cascade.
alex (oncall): any recent deploys to model-backend-2 or routing changes?
deploy-bot: deploy completed: model-backend-2 revision=rev-2026-03-15-14:58 by jay. canary traffic split 20% -> 100 instances. CI: green.
jay (runtime): I did the canary promotion at 14:58. The new variant contains a small heap tuning change. nothing else changed in gateway.
megan (sre): correlate host metrics for model-backend-2 instances around 14:55-15:05. if GC or oom events show up that supports heap/GC hypothesis.
cho (ingress): running `rg "upstream=model-backend-2" /var/log/gateway/* | awk '{print $1,$2,$6,$9}'` — seeing a tight cluster of timeouts between 15:01:50-15:02:20 across 6 nodes.
raj (support): heads-up: we started receiving user reports at 15:04 UTC. Ticket RED-4321 from Acme: "generation failing with 502". Customer impact: 4 orgs reported errors, 2 severe.
emily (product): logging customer impact: top-affected customers: Acme, NovaPay. tagging sales for escalation.
alex (oncall): immediate mitigations proposed: 1) revert canary (rollback rev-2026-03-15-14:58) 2) enable route fallback to model-backend-stable 3) temporary scale up model-backend pool. which to do first?
jay (runtime): recommend route fallback + rollback. fallback is fast and preserves traffic while rollback completes.
megan (sre): agree. fallback first to stop retries targeting the problematic variant. do we have a one-click route fallback?
cho (ingress): yes. applying fallback now: `redwood route set /v1/generate -> model-backend-stable --force`
cho (ingress): applied at 15:11:05 UTC.
alex (oncall): monitoring error rate.
megan (sre): metrics: 5xx rate started dropping ~15:13, significant drop by 15:16. linking dashboard: https://dash.redwood.test/d/ingress/errors?from=15:00&to=15:30
deploy-bot: rollback job queued: rollback rev-2026-03-15-14:58 -> rev-2026-03-14-22:10. started at 15:12:20 UTC.
jay (runtime): rollback completed 15:17:42 UTC.
alex (oncall): observed errors return to baseline by 15:22 UTC. impact window ~15:01-15:22.
megan (sre): current hypothesis list (tracked here for RCA):
1) regression in rev-2026-03-15-14:58 causing backend stalls -> upstream timeouts & retry amplification.
2) traffic-splitting + retries amplified request fanout -> gateway queueing and increased latency.
3) insufficient headroom on model-backend-2 autoscale config slowed recovery.
we'll add more after log/metric correlation.
cho (ingress): saved timeline artifact: https://logs.redwood.test/timeline/2265432100 (includes corr ids and kvlog excerpts).
raj (support): customer comms: sent interim update to Acme at 15:25 UTC — "we identified an issue and reverted a recent change; monitoring shows recovery." Ticket RED-4321 updated.
emily (product): can we prioritize postmortem to decide whether to block that config change from auto-promote and require longer canary?
jay (runtime): yes. propose increasing canary duration and add pod-level mem/GC monitoring alert.
megan (sre): next steps for RCA thread: collect heap/GC logs from model-backend-2 hosts, collect full request traces for sample corr ids (e.g., 02f1e2a3, 7b9c4d11, a4c2f8ee), evaluate retry policy behavior. I'll own trace aggregation.
alex (oncall): assigning follow-ups: megan -> trace + metrics correlation, jay -> reproduce locally with rev-2026-03-15-14:58, cho -> route/fallback playbook update, raj -> customer impact summary.
alex (oncall): handing off to Megan for deep-dive. closing live mitigation. If anything reappears ping this thread. :white_check_mark:
megan (sre): taking over. I’ll open an RCA doc and link back here.
deploy-bot: incident tag applied: incident/2265432100.
alex (oncall): thanks team — good quick coordination.
megan (sre): next note: please upload any relevant GC logs to /mnt/rca/2265432100/ so we have artifacts.
